component.name: Apache Libcloud
component.description: Python library providing a unified API for interacting with many cloud service providers (compute, storage, DNS, load balancers) through per-provider drivers.

externalReferences.comment: Source security page; this file is a structured translation of it. The page is a vulnerability-reporting policy plus a list of three historical security advisories; it does not describe a general threat model.

threats.name: CVE-2013-6480: data recoverable from destroyed DigitalOcean nodes
threats.description: DigitalOcean changed its default API behaviour from scrub to non-scrub when destroying a VM, and Libcloud 0.12.3 to 0.13.3 did not explicitly send the scrub_data query parameter when destroying a node, so nodes destroyed using Libcloud were vulnerable to later customers stealing data contained on them. Severity low; only users of the DigitalOcean driver were affected. Fixed in 0.13.3.

threats.name: CVE-2012-3446: SSL MITM via invalid hostname-verification regular expression
threats.description: When establishing a TLS connection, Libcloud 0.4.2 to 0.11.1 used an invalid regular expression for hostname verification: a subset instead of the full target server hostname was accepted as a match, so a certificate for aexample.com was considered valid for example.com, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks. Severity medium. Discovered by researchers from the University of Texas at Austin. Fixed in 0.11.1.

threats.name: CVE-2010-4340: SSL MITM due to missing certificate validation
threats.description: The Python SSL library did not validate host SSL certificates, so all Libcloud versions prior to 0.4.2 were vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks. Severity medium. Fixed in 0.4.2; users must also set libcloud.security.VERIFY_SSL_CERT to True.

controls.name: Upgrade to releases with the published fixes
controls.description: Each published advisory was fixed in a specific release: CVE-2013-6480 in 0.13.3 (DigitalOcean driver users strongly encouraged to upgrade), CVE-2012-3446 in 0.11.1, and CVE-2010-4340 in 0.4.2; users should upgrade to those versions or higher.

controls.name: Enable SSL certificate verification
controls.description: After upgrading to 0.4.2 or later, set the libcloud.security.VERIFY_SSL_CERT variable to True so target server certificates are validated.
